checks_run.procedure: D-068 from the domain and bilingual angle. POST raw UTF-8 bytes of Arabic, emoji, RLM/LRM and ZWJ to the charter (with Content-Length and chunked), and once with a leading BOM. Search transformations by Arabic text the way the web client's URLSearchParams sends it ('+' as space, %2B as a literal plus, a leading RLM). Send undecodable query components. Send an invisible-only charter value. Check the EN and AR messages for each code.
checks_run.expected: Valid Arabic/emoji/RLM bytes give 201 and are stored code point for code point. One BOM is accepted. Invalid bytes give 400 problem+json validation.json with nothing stored. Arabic queries give 200 and find the record. Undecodable queries give 400 validation.format at /query/q. Invisible-only gives 400 validation.blank. EN and AR messages exist for all three codes.

All 8 invalid-byte cases give 400 application/problem+json [['','validation.json']] and no charter. Arabic '+'-space, %2B and RLM-prefixed queries give 200 and the record is found. %FF, %ED%A0%80 and %D8 give 400 [['/query/q','validation.format']]. Invisible-only gives 400 validation.blank.
